reviews.text:
The wonderful Hughes Martinat, after a thorough consultation, provides follow-up care for your pet for three months, during which time you can contact him if you have any concerns or questions.

I consulted him about my cat, who was usually very gentle but had started attacking me at night, sometimes so violently that I considered giving him up. This devastated me because this cat, whom I had adopted from a rescue organization, was usually very sweet and affectionate.
After analyzing the aggression, Hughes Martinat concluded that my cat simply needed to channel his predatory instincts through play (a telescopic fishing rod toy is fantastic!) and other means, including interactive food bowls.
Since I've been dedicating time to playing with him, making him jump and run, my cat hasn't attacked me anymore and is even more affectionate. I am very grateful to Hughes Martinat.

I had a bad experience with Mr. Martinat, who spent an hour and a half at my house asking me questions that sometimes had nothing to do with the problem, without even bothering to see my cat. He then sends standard documents by email, and you're left to figure it out yourself. The worst part was the Pipolino, a medium-sized one that intimidated my cat, but Mr. Martinat insisted on not getting the smaller size. As a result, he went 48 hours without eating. He also made me feel guilty, saying that I wasn't taking care of my cat (and that this, he claimed, explained his behavior), even though he has regular vet checkups. As for calling him when needed, you get the feeling you're bothering him. In fact, I made the mistake of contacting him before my vacation, so my service was reduced by a month without any compensation. In short, I solved the problem myself, and I don't recommend using this man unless you want to waste your money.

I found Mr. Martinat's guidance very informative and highly recommend him. He helped me better understand how my cat Romeo functions; why he could have aggressive outbursts or seem frustrated with food. I felt helpless and wasn't implementing the right solutions. Thanks to Hugues' protocol, I can not only decipher Romeo's body language, but I've also created playful situations at home to keep my cat as stimulated as possible. The method quickly proved effective, and Romeo is no longer frustrated like before 🐾. Thank you again!

After consulting two other behaviorists, Hugues Martinat was able to identify the real reasons for my cat's inappropriate elimination. Thanks to his attentive listening and advice, my cat received effective treatment. Always available, he knows how to support both the cat and the owner.

I recommend him without hesitation.

Mr. Martinat did an incredible job helping our two cats, Spookie and Romy, to live together peacefully. We had a very difficult situation to resolve; for seven months we tried to manage it on our own by arranging exchanges between the two cats (who were living separately at the time), but without success. The female was very stressed, and the male was a bit too insistent. We thought we wouldn't succeed.

But it only took three months of guidance from Mr. Martinat to finally achieve a peaceful coexistence. The process we implemented, along with his advice, worked remarkably well. Today, the two cats play together, even sleep together, and we can leave them alone in the house without any problems. They have accepted each other. This has eliminated a major source of stress for us.

Thank you again to Hugues, who, even remotely, will help you achieve your goal. All of this is done with kindness and while always being available.

Thanks to Mr. Martinat's observations and advice, I was able to resolve Myo's problem with inappropriate elimination. Since following his recommendations, things have returned to normal and my relationship with my cat has greatly improved. I am very satisfied, thank you!

Hugues Martinat helped us manage our cat's fairly frequent attacks. The appointment went very well; he really took the time to understand our relationship with our cat, asked many questions with genuine kindness, and provided a very factual and professional diagnosis. We never felt judged. We had numerous exchanges, always kind and professional. He adapted his action plan to our daily life and always answered all our questions and calls. After three months, we noticed a real improvement and regained peace in our relationship with our cat! Thank you again :)
Thanks to Mr. Martinat's intervention, excellent advice, and follow-up, we were able to build a peaceful relationship with our kitten. A huge thank you.

Thank you to Mr. Martinat for his availability, practical help, and attentive listening. A true professional, he made a very accurate assessment of our situation with Shanelle, our 3-year-old Siberian cat, who had been urinating outside the litter box several times a day for the past four months! It was a desperate situation for our family and for Shanelle. Since we started following his recommendations, the situation has improved very quickly and is now completely resolved, much to our delight! Shanelle is calmer, and we've discovered she's more affectionate and playful. Mr. Martinat helped us without judgment and always with kindness to find the source of the problem, working diligently and meticulously, giving generously of his time. He is available by phone and text, always ready to listen and support you throughout the process. Clearly, he loves cats, and you and your companion are in good hands, no matter where you live in France. We can't thank him enough!

I contacted Hugues Martignas in May 2024 regarding my cats' almost daily urine marking.

The first consultation was via video call, followed by a report and detailed advice within a few days. I received follow-up phone calls for three months.
Everything resolved itself quite quickly, and six months after the end of the follow-up, I've only had two new instances of marking.
Depending on the case, expect to pay a similar amount to the consultation fee for various modifications and improvements to the cats' environment.
In the end, it's well worth the cost!
Thank you, Mr. Martignas.
Signed, the cats of Châteauroux.

Mr. Martinat was always available and gave me excellent advice regarding one of my cats' litter box problems. He even went a step further by suggesting I change how I fed my cats, which helped the greediest one lose weight and curbed his tendency to tease his feline friend! I am very grateful and recommend him without hesitation: his analysis and answers to all my questions were, and still are, a great help.

Thank you to Mr. Martinat for saving my relationship with my cat, Paillette. I adopted this little kitten from the animal shelter after she was trapped. No one knew her history or even her age. She wouldn't let anyone near her, always kept her distance, urinated over the litter box, paced around the apartment, and meowed constantly (especially at night). I really felt like I'd made a huge mistake adopting her, that I was making her unhappy at home, and I was even considering giving her to someone with a garden so she could be more in her element. Mr. Martinat understood her problems perfectly, and thanks to his analysis and availability over three months, I understand Paillette and her needs much better. Now, six months after she came to live with me, there's harmony between us.
